info.title: Chip In Sales Assistant Firestore Reader
info.description: Read-only access to the verified Chip In Sales Assistant feed stored in Firestore. Parse fields.todayJson and fields.pipelineJson as JSON. Never invent sales facts that are not present in the document.

get.summary: Get Chip's current verified sales actions and pipeline
get.description: Returns one Firestore document. fields.todayJson.stringValue contains the current due-action payload as JSON. fields.pipelineJson.stringValue contains the prospect pipeline as JSON.
